data.narrative:
CruxOCM is a Series A climate and energy company founded by Roger Shirt and Vicki Knott that has raised $26.1M to date. The relevant comp universe includes one public company (LNZA) and eight private peers in the Climate & Energy sector, including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

Stage-progression analysis is the applicable valuation method here. Using total capital raised ($26.1M) as a proxy for current valuation and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A-to-subsequent-stage advancement yields an implied valuation of $52.2M. This method reflects the incremental value creation expected between funding rounds in this sector and stage.

Peer-median analysis was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparable data within the narrow peer set; while eight Climate & Energy companies exist in the comp universe, none of the same-stage or similarly-tiered subsets contained the minimum three datapoints required for reliable median-based triangulation. The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $44M to $60M, with a median of $52M. Key uncertainties include the strength of the Technology and team execution relative to stage peers, and near-term capital efficiency and product-market fit validation, which will materially inform post-Series A valuations.
